name: Saimin Class Wonderful ~Joshi Zen'in, Shiranai Uchi ni Mata Ninshin Shitemashita~
original_name: 催眠クラス WONDERFUL ～女子全員、知らないうちにまた妊娠してました～
source: The protagonist is a gullible high school student living with his sister. Doing his usual wasteful spending he finds a magazine that guarantees the ability to hypnotize people and orders it right away. After being caught by his sister wasting money again, he is forced to prove its worth. Using a magic coin he spins it, only to find out it doesn't work. In a last ditch effort he finds a random lighter in the package and eureka! his sister is hypnotized. Now he uses his new hypnotizing lighter to spice up his school life.
translation: 主角是一个容易上当受骗的高中生，和他的妹妹住在一起。他像往常一样浪费钱，找到了一本保证能催眠人的杂志，并立即订购了它。在再次被姐姐发现浪费钱后，他被迫证明自己的价值。他用一枚神奇的硬币来旋转它，却发现它不起作用。在最后的努力中，他在包裹中随机发现了一个打火机，然后发现了！他的妹妹被催眠了。现在，他用新的催眠打火机为他的学校生活增添情趣。
